name: gantry-yard
source_reference: User brief: white-background icon combining a railway junction yard with a large station gantry that hides route reassignment
brief: Warm-white field. Four tracks enter from the left, are reorganized beneath a large near-black station gantry, and leave toward different heights on the right. One amber route and one blue entry signal show active routing without labels.

semantic_review.basis: original low-risk concept drawn directly from the Token Station routing metaphor
semantic_review.notes: The central gantry is the dominant silhouette; track crossings remain subordinate and partially hidden.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: preserve the large station gantry, multiple reordered tracks, and one selected route
must_preserve: tracks enter and leave at different heights
must_not_add: text, numbers, arrows, train, sleepers, map labels, nodes, shadows, gradients, or platform frame
acceptance_checks: reads as tracks passing through a station structure
does not read as USB or a node graph

composer.reason: multiple flat track ribbons should remain editable
